bestBets.overview: Showers about each and every day on the 'Sunshine Coast'. Dear oh dear, week in week out year in year out, good tracks are few and far between here. Rail out 9m can see those on the pace having the advantage. Kick the eight race card off with a 1800m Maiden Hcp. No pace race on paper, perhaps no's 1,2,7 settle forward. FIREY TRUTH maps a treat for Nick Heywood, 4th run in can be ready run to its best. NARUKAMI is 3rd-up, at only prior campaign the 3rd start was where  it showed up, placing a two lengths 3rd. It maps to get a lovely run as well. FIVE OF US long overdue but it too maps well and partakes 'in-form'.

raceTips.comment: Sunshine Coast racing on Sunday will take place on a soft (7) rated track. We get the new season underway with an 1800m maiden where I'm leaning to Fiery Truth however with little confidence. The effort at Grafton was sound enough & this is certainly no harder, placed on a heavy (10) two back is a decent recommendation should the track deteriorate. Mister Blaze has had his share of chances however can fill a placing.

bestBets.overview: 1000m QTIS 3yo Maiden Plate. A dozen can run but won't. Just three will now be on debut, three will be 1st-up from a spell. All respect to the market moves as they make their way to the starting stalls. Who looks fit, who appears calm etc etc. TOMMY TIE has the benefit of recent racing, placed at Eagle Farm last start albeit that was on a good 4. Sting-out could be an obstacle. IT'SALL ABOUT MARY resumes, won a recent trial. She contested stronger races on debut and again prior to spelling, in between runnered-up at Rockhampton, that form-line is okay. CEDRELA resumes. Heavily backed on debut, was outpaced but was also never on the track. He's been gelded and won a recent trial stylishly at Doomben.  Like the late riding engagement too. Re the newcomers, EMBER ROYALE  won recent trial by 3 lengths but the two up front ran off the track and this was ridden along to some extent.

raceTips.comment: Plenty of debutantes going around here & with the wet track some may wait for another day. Betting moves obviously all important around the ones who do turn up. Cedrela was out of the money when well backed here on Boxing Day. Spelled & trialled well leading into his return, I'll lean his way. Tommy Tie placed in town last start, wasn't the strongest of races however good enough for this.

bestBets.overview: 1800m C4. No's 4 and 8 the remaining pace. STRANGLEHOLD would have taken plenty of beating, opted for town yesterday where it wasn't up that task. Back to back BM65  wins on soft 5 tracks then had a throw at the stumps in town on a Saturday and was far from disgraced, finishing 4th a tick over 2 1/2 lengths from the winner. Leah Martyn provides some weight relief. No idea why CHASSAGNE resumed at Randwick, sp'd $101 which was 'generous' of the bookies. #Not. Is just 2nd-up today but is two from five when 2nd-up and with Ben Thompson aboard has all the feels of a significant improver. THINKING GOLD ran well fresh, it too is a ripper 2nd-up, alas it is out as it placed 3rd in town yesterday (without excuse) . DOUBLE WHAMMY won't know itself, dropping 6.5 kg's. So many winners fit that profile. BIG TICKET BOY now maps a treat.

Sticking to the 1000m is the perfect plan for this horse. Resuming new blood with Gollan via OUT OF SQUARE. She reads like a dry-tracker. The stable also saddles up KIWI RAIDER which just so happened to be freshened new blood when winning well as expected here last start.  MEHRETU a complete forgive fresh, been scratched more times since than I've had birthdays, and is scratched again. JIMMY'S BROTHER maps a treat.

raceTips.comment: Newcomer to the Gollan stable Kiwi Raider was far too speedy for his rivals when produced first up here over his 1000m trip 3 weeks ago. bestBets.overview: 1600m BM58. No's 2,3,4,8,9,10,13 can have designs on settling handy, the latter most likely is the leader. OUT OF LUCK strips fitter again, gets to pet distance and loves the sting out of the track. KAFFIR LILY has had excuses both starts this time in, would include if support arrived. They knew BADDA BOOM BABY would improve more than ten lengths last start, not dismissing lightly now. A few others lining up here were behind it there and on that small sample cannot suggest any will turn the tables today but in this class little comes as a surprise.

raceTips.comment: We wind up the afternoon with a mile BM58 over 1600m. Open race as you would expect where I'll lean to Out Of Luck who finished in the placings second up at the Gold Coast & should be further improved here, note yet to miss a placing over this trip & that includes a win. Don't know where the Badda Boom Baby win came from last start however should she replicate that has to be in the picture once again.
